z3.reason: UNSAT: observable A causes no backaction on B AND [A,B]!=0 — incompatible observables always have mutual backaction by quantum mechanics

clifford.reason: observables as Clifford basis elements; commutator [A,B]=A*B-B*A as grade-2 component; zero grade-2 content = zero backaction condition

P1_pytorch_bell_measurement_backaction_o.description: Pytorch: measuring qubit 1 in Bell state updates qubit 2 — sz_before=0, sz_post_0=+1, sz_post_1=-1 (backaction)

P2_pytorch_product_state_no_backaction.description: Pytorch: measuring qubit 1 of product state |+>|+> does not change qubit 2 expectations — no backaction for separable state

P3_sympy_sz_sx_same_qubit_commutator_non.description: Sympy: [sigma_z, sigma_x] ≠ 0 on same qubit — incompatible single-qubit observables cause backaction; also [sz⊗I, sx⊗I] ≠ 0

P4_sympy_sz_z_commutes_with_itself.description: Sympy: [sigma_z⊗I, sigma_z⊗I] = 0 — observable commutes with itself, repeated measurement causes no additional backaction

P5_clifford_sz_sx_commutator_grade2_nonz.description: Clifford: [e1, e2] = 2*e12 has nonzero grade-2 component — backaction encoded as bivector part of algebra commutator

P6_clifford_sz_commutes_with_itself_zero.description: Clifford: [e1, e1] = 0 — same observable has zero commutator, no backaction on repeated measurement

P7_rustworkx_backaction_graph_structure.description: Rustworkx: backaction graph has 2 edges ([sz,sx] and [sz,sy] nonzero); sigma_z_q2 isolated — compatible with sigma_z_q1

P8_pytorch_measurement_probabilities_sum.description: Pytorch: measurement probabilities for Bell state sum to 1 — POVM completeness

N1_z3_unsat_no_backaction_with_nonzero_c.description: Z3 UNSAT: no backaction AND [A,B]!=0 — incompatible observables always cause mutual backaction

N2_pytorch_maximally_mixed_no_backaction.description: Negative: maximally mixed 2-qubit state — measuring qubit 1 does not disturb qubit 2 (no entanglement to carry backaction)

N3_sympy_same_observable_commutes.description: Negative sympy: [I⊗sz, I⊗sz] = 0 — same observable on same qubit commutes, no backaction on repeat measurement

N4_sympy_sz_i_commutes_with_itself.description: Negative sympy: [sz⊗I, sz⊗I] = 0 — commuting observable, no backaction

N5_clifford_e1_commutes_with_e1.description: Negative Clifford: [e1, e1] = 0 — grade-2 commutator is zero, same Pauli measured twice has no backaction

N6_rustworkx_different_qubit_observables.description: Negative: sigma_z⊗I and I⊗sigma_x commute (different qubits) — no backaction between observables on separate subsystems

B1_pytorch_z_eigenstate_no_disturbance.description: Boundary: eigenstate |00> of sigma_z measurement — no disturbance, prob_0=1, prob_1=0

B2_pytorch_product_measurement_qubit2_un.description: Boundary: |+>|0> product state — measuring qubit 1 in Z does not change qubit 2 (still |0>)

B3_sympy_sz_commutes_with_sz_boundary.description: Boundary sympy: repeated sigma_z measurement commutes with itself — no backaction on same observable

B4_z3_sat_compatible_observables_no_back.description: Boundary z3 SAT: [A,B]=0 AND no backaction is consistent — compatible observables can be jointly measured

B5_clifford_commutator_lives_in_grade2.description: Boundary Clifford: [e1,e2] = 2*e12 — backaction (commutator) lives purely in grade-2 bivector subspace

B6_rustworkx_all_pauli_pairs_have_backac.description: Boundary: all 3 Pauli pairs have nonzero commutator — 3-clique in backaction graph; no Pauli pair is compatible

B7_pytorch_measurement_channel_trace_pre.description: Boundary: averaged post-measurement state has Tr=1 — measurement channel is trace-preserving
